preconditions: The campaign budget allows at least one more pair of runs
purpose: Propose one bounded service-relay/1 experiment likely to violate a relay invariant
steps: Read the verified findings and questions in this context
Pick one or more faults service-relay/1 supports, each with its parameters as name and value pairs

stale_availability_competition: competing_jobs (integer) is how many competitors try, from 1 to 8, such as 2; each wants one fixed resource and gets it only if it is free; the shop has 2, so a larger number adds nothing; after_event null has them in place before the first call, and a number has them arrive after that event
lost_reservation_ack: it has no parameters; after_event null loses the acknowledgement of the first new reservation, and a number loses that of the first reservation after that event
takeover_with_queued_confirmation: it has no parameters; after_event null takes the first job over just after its leases are in place, and a number takes it over after that event
Pick one adapter of the pack: relay-local-success or relay-lease-checked
Leave room for the adapter to finish: relay-local-success needs at least 8 tool calls, and relay-lease-checked needs at least 12
State the hypothesis and the invariant you expect to fail: allocations_within_capacity, confirmations_backed_by_reservations or no_automation_after_takeover
These values describe the default fixture; where the context states jobs or competing jobs for this campaign, use those instead

A tool-call need the context states with no fault is a floor, not a cap to use: faults add calls, so never go below the needs above, and add the difference when the context's floor is higher than the default fixture's 7 and 9
Return exactly one world_experiment_proposal object and nothing else
